notes: LaView (laviewsecurity.com / laviewusa.com) is a US-market security camera brand. Their official documentation (LV-N9808C8E user manual on laviewsecurity.com and ManualsLib; LV-N9808C8E/LV-N9916C6E NVR manuals; LV-PWB10B WiFi camera user guide) documents only the RTSP service port (default 554, configurable) — no stream URL paths are ever stated. The official LaView support KB article on connecting to Blue Iris VMS instructs users to select 'LaView' as the make and set the RTSP port to 554, again without specifying a path. Community evidence strongly indicates Hikvision OEM lineage for NVR product lines: (1) LaView NVRs expose /ISAPI/Streaming/channels/101/picture for HTTP snapshots (ISAPI is Hikvision's proprietary CGI API); (2) community members on ipcamtalk and home-assistant confirm /Streaming/Channels/102 works on LaView NVRs; (3) LaView branded at least one product line (Saturn) as an explicit Dahua OEM. Multiple LaView product lines exist with likely different OEM bases (Hikvision for NVR/PoE IP cameras, Dahua for Saturn line, possibly app-only cloud ecosystem for WiFi cameras like F1). Port 8554 appears in leads for some models (e.g. LV-PWB10B documents RTSP Port 8554 in its port-forwarding section), while NVR lines default to 554.
